queries.name: session_latest
queries.sql: SELECT message_id, role, classification FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=? ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT ?

queries.name: session_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=?

queries.name: recent_sessions
queries.sql: SELECT conversation_id, updated_utc FROM conversations ORDER BY updated_utc DESC LIMIT ?

queries.name: message_classification
queries.sql: SELECT classification, COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=? GROUP BY classification ORDER BY classification
